nodes.name: Pt Electrodeposition on (Co,Ni)(OH)₂/C
nodes.procedure: The Pt/(Co,Ni)(OH)₂/C samples with different loadings were successfully synthesized by varying the electrodeposition time in a 1.0 mmol L⁻¹ H₂PtCl₆ solution at -0.8 V vs. SCE, and the Pt species were loaded on (Co,Ni)(OH)₂ NPs by in situ nucleation and growth. The 1.41 wt% Pt sample was obtained after 20 s electrodeposition.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns show diffraction peak at 26.1° for carbon (002); crystal phases identified as hybridization of hexagonal β-Co(OH)₂ (JCPDS 30-0443) and β-Ni(OH)₂ (JCPDS 14-0117); no Pt peaks observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The apparent diffraction peak at 26.1° is assigned to carbon (002)... The crystal phases... identified to be the hybridization of the hexagonal trigonal β-Co(OH)₂ (JCPDS-No. 30-0443) and β-Ni(OH)₂ (JCPDS-No. 14-0117) structure... no diffraction peak of Pt species is observed...

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt 4f binding energies show positive shift in Pt₁/(Co,Ni)(OH)₂/C relative to Pt₁/C, indicating reduced electron density on Pt; Co 2p shows oxidized Co(OH)₂ state; Ni 2p confirms Ni(OH)₂; Pt present as Pt(0) and Ptδ⁺ (δ=0-2).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The binding energies of Pt 4f in Pt₁/(Co,Ni)(OH)₂/C show a positive shift relative to Pt₁/C... the surface Co species... mainly present in an oxidized state as confirmed... Co(OH)₂. The XPS spectra of Ni 2p... Ni species exist in the form of Ni(OH)₂... Pt was present as Pt(0) and Ptδ⁺...
